dialogues.jp: 目覚ましを枕元に置き、机の前に戻る。
dialogues.en:
I place the alarm clock back at my bedside, and return to my
desk.
dialogues.text:
I place the alarm clock back at my bedside, and return to my
desk.

dialogues.en: "Hum, the three houses of Tokugawa are..."
dialogues.text: "Hum, the three houses of Tokugawa are..."

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましをセットして、俺はまた徳川御三家へ
と視線を移した。本家は全員、竹千代のくせに。
dialogues.en:
After setting the alarm clock, my eyes returned to the
Tokugawa shogunate.
dialogues.text:
